Hair growth serums `support scalp health, reinforce hair roots, and reduce shedding` , using a mix of botanical extracts, peptides, and active ingredients.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/hair-growth-serums)[[2]](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/beauty/best-scalp-serums-for-hair-growth)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7551692515081888860,catalogid:6641307185671627916,gpcid:3232150281943292529,mid:576462872485034088&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://vegamour.com/products/gro-hair-serum)[[5]](https://www.ncoa.org/product-resources/hair-loss/best-hair-growth-serums/)[[6]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17747222009407428185,catalogid:9114148950494473691,gpcid:6338084888880786793,mid:576462374527879519&ibp=oshop)[[7]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17745003848868708366,catalogid:11914330086211169201,gpcid:18358599228243049767,mid:576462609564456429&ibp=oshop)

Uses strengthening peptides and caffeine in a lightweight, water-based, leave-in formula.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17747222009407428185,catalogid:9114148950494473691,gpcid:6338084888880786793,mid:576462374527879519&ibp=oshop)Features an 18% concentration of active ingredients designed to target hair fall and stimulate follicles.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17745003848868708366,catalogid:11914330086211169201,gpcid:18358599228243049767,mid:576462609564456429&ibp=oshop)Drug-free, botanical-based formulas with ashwagandha exosomes and plant extracts to support density and reduce shedding.[[1]](https://www.ncoa.org/product-resources/hair-loss/best-hair-growth-serums/)A fast-absorbing, water-based formula utilizing red clover and mung bean to improve scalp health and prevent shedding.[[1]](https://vegamour.com/products/gro-hair-serum)[[2]](https://www.ncoa.org/product-resources/hair-loss/best-hair-growth-serums/)Budget-friendly, water-based option powered by a longevity complex to hydrate the scalp and reinforce roots.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7551692515081888860,catalogid:6641307185671627916,gpcid:3232150281943292529,mid:576462872485034088&ibp=oshop)Show more

### Key Ingredients to Look For

- **Peptides & Caffeine:** Stimulate blood circulation in the scalp and signal follicles.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gAnRbXWZjsw)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17747222009407428185,catalogid:9114148950494473691,gpcid:6338084888880786793,mid:576462374527879519&ibp=oshop)
- **Redensyl, Capixyl, & Procapil:** Plant-based and patented complexes that target the anagen (growth) phase and reduce root-level hair fall.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/WishCare-Hair-Growth-Serum-Concentrate/dp/B0B573QW21)[[2]](https://www.ncoa.org/product-resources/hair-loss/best-hair-growth-serums/)
- **Botanicals & Oils:** Rosemary oil, green tea extract, and saw palmetto help calm inflammation and support a balanced scalp microbiome.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/hair-growth-serums)[[2]](https://www.ncoa.org/product-resources/hair-loss/best-hair-growth-serums/)

### What to Expect

- **Timeframe:** Most non-prescription serums require **3 to 6 months** of consistent daily use before visible changes in thickness or shedding appear.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DZKhzx2yQgr/?hl=en)[[2]](https://vegamour.com/products/gro-hair-serum)
- **Difference from Medically Proven Treatments:** Over-the-counter cosmetic serums improve hair appearance and scalp condition, whereas FDA-approved treatments like **topical minoxidil (Rogaine)** have direct clinical backing for regrowing hair in androgenetic alopecia.[[1]](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored/beauty/best-scalp-serums-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.allure.com/story/hair-growth-serums)[[3]](https://www.kerastase-usa.com/oils-and-serums/hair-serums)[[4]](https://www.ncoa.org/product-resources/hair-loss/best-hair-growth-serums/)

If you'd like to narrow down your options, let me know:

- Are you dealing with **general shedding, thinning at the crown, or post-partum hair loss**?
- Do you prefer a **budget-friendly** option or a **clinical/botanical** formula?
